name: cnn-stock-pred-nyse
description: This datasets covers features from various categories of technical indicators, futures contracts, price of commodities, important indices of markets around the world, price of major companies in the U.S. market, and treasury bill rates. Sources and thorough description of features have been mentioned in the paper of 'CNNpred: CNN-based stock market prediction using a diverse set of variables.This dataset only contains information from the NYSE.
creator: Ehsan Hoseinzade
